1.translation: By the sky full of constellations,

3.translation: and by the witness and the witnessed,

4.translation: cursed be the makers of the trench[1],
4.footnotes: [1] Those who worked for a tyrannical king and did not allow the people to believe in Allah. Their blind obedience to their ruler incurred upon them the curse of Allah.

7.translation: and were witnessing what they did to the believers[2].
7.footnotes: [2] After the believers were casted into a trench of fire, they sat around it watching them burn to death. It occurred long before Prophet Muhammad's (ﷺ) time.

8.translation: Their only grievance against them was that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Praiseworthy,

9.translation: to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and Allah is Witness over all things.

10.translation: Indeed, for those who tortured the believing men and women, and then did not repent, there will be the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the burning fire[3].
10.footnotes: [3] Those who burned the believers will be punished with the burning fire in the Hereafter.

11.translation: But those who believed and did righteous deeds will certainly have gardens under which rivers flow; that is the supreme triumph.

12.translation: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is severe.

13.translation: Indeed, it is He Who originates [the creation] and then resurrects all,

14.translation: and He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Affectionate,

15.translation: the Lord of the Glorious Throne;

17.translation: Has there not come to you the story of the forces

19.translation: But the disbelievers are in persistent denial,

20.translation: although Allah encompasses them from all sides.

21.translation: But this is a glorious Qur’an,
